summary: CivicState is useful civic automation, but still watchlist until paid delivery is proven.
authority: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption -- operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

methods: Read root files, hidden planning artifacts, and selected source files [evidence: repo inspection]
Cited repo and dispatch as evidence; tagged external or forward-looking claims as assumptions [evidence: user brief]
Created default wrk gate shape because no native gate artifact existed [evidence: repo inspection]
sources: apps/api, apps/web, apps/worker, packages/shared/prisma/schema.prisma [evidence: repo source]

thesis.current: A constrained transactional civic-letter product may earn modest cash flow if users pay $5 to $25 per submission [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/payments.ts], but it is not yet venture-ready [assumption: no live market proof in repo].
thesis.operatorSensitivity: Registry note says personal/research asset and asks operator to confirm whether it should pitch as a business [evidence: dispatch registry note].

customerDefinition.primary: Individual US residents with a specific civic issue and desired outcome [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].
customerDefinition.excluded: Legal advice, claim filing, regulatory submission, private-individual targeting, business advocacy, harassment, and defamation-sensitive uses [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md].

unvalidatedClaims: 88% to 92% gross margin [assumption: inherited repo model, no live bills]
$1.20 variable COGS per order [assumption: inherited repo model]
$200 monthly fixed cost [assumption: inherited repo model]

marketSizing.beachhead: 10,000 relevant annual visitors x 3% paid conversion x $15 average order value = $4,500 annual gross revenue [assumption: placeholder visitors; evidence: conversion gate and pricing from repo].
marketSizing.scaleCase: 50 comparable wedges x $4,500 = $225,000 annual gross revenue [assumption: unvalidated expansion model].
marketSizing.conclusion: Currently too small for VC unless repeat use, organizational buying, higher-ticket workflow, or data/API revenue appears [assumption: EIR judgment].

competition: Resistbot [assumption: repo-identified substitute, not externally verified]
Change.org [assumption: repo-identified substitute, not externally verified]
LegalZoom [assumption: repo-identified substitute, not externally verified]
Quorum and VoterVoice [assumption: repo-identified enterprise substitutes, pricing unverified]
Manual email to officials [assumption: user alternative]

financials.breakEvenSketch: 25 monthly submissions x $15 AOV = $375 gross revenue; minus $30 variable COGS and $200 fixed cost = $145 before labor [assumption: arithmetic from repo pricing and inherited cost model].
financials.spendLimits: $300 daily token cap and $25 single-job escalation threshold [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md]

risksAntiPlan: May be useful but not venture-scale [assumption: EIR judgment].
Government email deliverability can kill the value proposition [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].
Citation hallucination or unverifiable claims can damage trust and create legal exposure [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/researcher.ts].
Local official data provider remains unresolved [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].
Do not raise institutional capital, expand community features, or launch nationally before a constrained paid wedge works [assumption: EIR recommendation].

assumptionLedger.assumption: Users will pay the $5 to $25 package range [evidence: implemented pricing; assumption: demand unproven]
3% conversion is reachable [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md; assumption: not measured]
85% government inbox placement is reachable [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md; assumption: not measured]
60% local official coverage is reachable [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md; assumption: not measured]

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.hole: No live revenue evidence [evidence: repo inspection]
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Run constrained paid beta before investor narrative
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: Users may not pay even if the product works [assumption: market risk]

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.hole: Planning artifacts conflict on completion state [evidence: .planning/ROADMAP.md and .planning/STATE.md]
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Use root ROADMAP.md as forward validation roadmap
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: Underlying implementation may be less complete than planned [assumption: execution risk]

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.hole: No external market research in this pass [evidence: user brief]
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Mark all market claims as assumptions
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: Competitor, vendor, legal, and market facts may be stale [assumption: freshness risk]

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.hole: Legal/compliance boundary is narrow [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md and moderation code]
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Human review and strict excluded-use policy
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: Edge cases may still create reputational or legal exposure [assumption: compliance risk]

sequence: Pick one metro and one issue category [assumption: EIR recommendation]
Manually verify officials and delivery path [assumption: EIR recommendation]
Recruit 5 to 10 beta users [assumption: inherited soft-launch design]
Measure payment, delivery, bounce, reply, refund, and support load [assumption: validation plan]

roadmap.shape: Single-worker-sized validation actions tied to BUSINESS.md headings [evidence: ROADMAP.md]

staleAreas: Vendor pricing after March 2026 [assumption: temporal risk]
Legal disclosure obligations [assumption: no legal review]

operatorQuestions: Should this remain a personal/research asset or be pitched as a business? [evidence: dispatch registry note]
Which metro and issue category should define the first beta wedge? [assumption: GTM dependency]
Who will own human review and legal boundary decisions during beta? [assumption: operational dependency]
